posts.name: McBehrer
posts.cooked:
Man, I was doing really well and then they kept doing the EXACT OPPOSITE of what I needed them to do. 

I was on Drawn Deadly Attention, so I had sent my one hero who was really low over as a peace offering, but instead he decided to switch Zones and kill my 4 healthy heroes instead.

 

Then later, I had it set up so Voss was alone with ObliVAeon, and they had 13 destruction tokens, so they each were going to hurt each other pretty bad. Instead, he plays Relentless Hunter and LEAVES OBLIVAEON ALONE to pick on the heroes. THANKS, Voss. You had ONE JOB.

I somehow managed to beat ObliVAeon, even though I went into the last round with him at full health (Legacy + El Legado Mejor on La Comodora, with Paradoja Figurehead, and the Mecha Knight and multiple power uses meant I just chewed through his health)

 

Unfortunately, I didn't realize Voss still destroyed environments, so I lost on his first turn. Still, it was cool.

posts.name: The PayneTrayne
posts.cooked: I lost the first game; I couldn't overcome OblivAeon's "Destroy 4 aeon men in one turn" shield. Either not enough would come out, or they'd be split between zones. I thought mercing Aeon Master would do the trick, but nope. I even tried resorting to using Omnitron-X and Argent Adept's Dark Dynamics power just to speed things, but to no avail. Did get to see Ra and Writhe have fun with an Infinity Cannon and Chekhov's Hairdryer though.

posts.name: rjc917
posts.cooked: I got frustrated trying to flip the Source of Foes shield because Oblivaeon kept destroying all the Aeon Men before I could get 4 of them in one zone that were low enough to destroy in one turn.  So I decided to forget about Oblivaeon and make my own personal win condition to kill all the Scions, since the one time I played Oblivaeon before on the tabletop, I beat him, but barely touched the Scions.  Nixious had moved to zone 1 early, so zone 2 was empty for most of the game except for Zhu Long's ninjas fighting a few Aeon Men, which was fun to imagine.  Voss was tough to take down with his massive damage reduction, but the combo of Legacy, Suicide Ra, and PW Fanatic really helped.  I only ever got 2 rewards-Chronoist, who was quite helpful and got reclaimed a lot, and the Infinity Cannon, which got destroyed pretty early after being used once (although I'm not sure how I completed the mission to get it, since it just randomly flipped during a villain turn).  I relied on incap powers a lot though and even managed to finally flip Oblivaeon's shield while he was on his second form.  I noticed there didn't seem to be any benefit to removing the second part of the shield (at least that one) once Oblivaeon was past his first page though, since you've already removed the damage immunity.  Anyway, I was finally able to defeat the last Scion, just before Oblivaeon blew up the Nexus of the Void to end the game.
